scenes.text: On a number chart, check the size of a jump. Moving right or forward adds; moving left or backward subtracts.
What is 1 more than 9,955? The answer is 9,956. 9,955 plus 1 equals 9,956.
A chart on a football field lists steps of 1. The highlighted box is 49,827; what number is immediately after it? Pause to choose and explain.
